VBO:0200293.summary: Easygoing Roger offers one keeper’s view of the Carlin Pinscher, a developing North American companion type. JCF’s dogs join walks and couch time, while some have a stronger prey drive. Albert enjoyed hiking and, at about eighteen months, earned a Beginner Novice obedience title after three scores of 193 out of 200 in his first four-day show.
